narration.text: Every credit balance traced to whose money it is: Medicare overpayments returned inside 60 days, patients refunded, and posting errors corrected rather than refunded. This is a chore for the practice administrator of a three-clinician family practice that bills Medicare Part B and takes patient payments online and at the desk. Athena works it across 4 portals: Chartmend PM, Ledgerline, Novabridge MAC and Carenook. On the bench, she found 9 of 9 eligible items, worth 866 dollars and 8 cents of the 866 dollars and 8 cents there was to find. All 9 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 13 traps, and she walked past 13. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 52 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
